title: Great Barrier Reef Bleaching Returns Before Recovery Finishes
hook: Each new bleaching event arrives while the last recovery is unfinished.
closing: Repeated bleaching matters because interrupted recovery leaves the reef less time to rebuild.
question: Can the reef recover fast enough?

segments.say: The Great Barrier Reef has had three mass bleaching events this decade. An occasional shock became recurring damage.
The average bleaching gap since 2020 is two years. New damage now returns quickly.
A reef typically needs ten years to recover. The current bleaching pace interrupts that recovery window.
